title: App-context section recipe
description: A section recipe: a captured, addressable sub-page composition (an item header, a facet tab bar, a control bar) that page recipes reference by slug and the derive inlines. Authored at app-context/src/sections/<slug>.json and derived per slug to app-context/dist/sections/<slug>.json. Like a page recipe it is taken from the running product, never invented, so derivedFrom is required.

_meta.description: Stamped by the derive on the dist leaf only; absent from the authored source. Declared because the root is additionalProperties:false.

examples.do_not_edit: Edit the app-context/src/ files; CI regenerates this file.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier; must equal the filename minus .json. Page recipes reference it in a SECTION node.

description.description: What the part is and what it holds, in the product's order.
examples: Identity row (type tag, sharing tag, title, status tag, Actions button) over three metadata lines.

role.description: Where the part sits on a page. A consumer that composes a screen from an archetype rather than a capture picks sections by role.

apps.description: App slugs where this part appears. Must resolve against app-context apps.

patterns.description: Slugs of the app-context patterns whose pages carry this part. Must resolve against app-context patterns.

derivedFrom.description: Provenance. A section never compared against the product is a guess.

surface.description: The product surface the part was taken from, as a person would navigate to it.

capturedOn.description: ISO date the product screen was captured.

productVersion.description: Version or environment of the product captured, when known.

slots.description: Named sub-regions and what each holds, plus the product rule behind any {{placeholder}} the skeleton carries.

examples.identity: Type tag, sharing tag, item name; status tag and Actions on the right.

renderNotes.description: Renderer behaviours an author must know for this part to draw correctly.
examples: `fmTabs` reads `Tabs` and `Active`; a count goes into the label text.

skeleton.description: The part itself: `content` holds one or more sibling nodes that the derive splices in place of the SECTION node that references this section. No chrome, no appHeader: a section is not a page. Node-level shape is owned by the consuming renderer; every INSTANCE keeps its FM `ref` and may carry a `ds` slug for the DS-tier path.

content.description: Sibling nodes spliced in document order. A section holds at least one root node: an empty section splices nothing and is not a capture of anything.
